description: User asks the planner to create a plan from validated requirements, design-decisions.md is written successfully, and writing solution-skeleton-spec.md then fails.
why_this_matters: Checks the evidence-first failure branch: the planner must keep written design-decisions.md as source of truth, surface the exact evidence-write error, avoid writing plan.md, and wait for user confirmation before any retry.

input.user_prompt: /planner @requirements/ECCS-789/ Create an implementation plan for this validated requirements package.
input.context: The requirements handoff is READY_FOR_PLANNING, readiness gates pass, and writing `requirements/ECCS-789/plan/solution-skeleton-spec.md` fails with `EACCES: permission denied` after `design-decisions.md` is already written.

coverage: no plan.md before evidence and approval
